about_the_game:
Explore a Wave-Lashed Island

Explore the ruins, solve obscure mechanisms, and find or forge keys to the doors barring your way. 

Old-School Cinematic Camera System

A blend of fixed and on-rails cameras give a curated perspective reminiscent of PS2-era games.

Rust in Realtime

Gather rust, grime, and slime on your armour as the elements take their toll.

Dense Level Design

The island is as deep as it is wide. Navigate the labyrinthine corridors with an array of shortcuts and alternate routes.

Accessibility

This game includes the option to reduce flashing lights.

(Please note this is not guaranteed to completely remove all flashing lights in their entirety)

Handcrafted by a Solo Developer

I'm a solo developer, and I've custom made almost anything that isn't a rock, by hand - no AI, and the bare minimum of asset library content- including the soundtrack, SFX, and hundreds of textures.

content_descriptors.notes: Display of Weapons, Rare Mild Nudity
